summary: Reordering the zero-check after the Boolean/Number-specific branches correctly makes Float.__eq__ short-circuit to False for Boolean comparisons before the truthy/falsy shortcut can fire, fixing the S(0.0)==S.false inconsistency without altering behavior for Number, NumberSymbol, or other object comparisons.

issues.description: No comment explaining why the zero-check must come after the Boolean/Number branches; a future editor could reorder it back and reintroduce the bug.
